R1.description: The six multi-test classes above 200 s are split into smaller sibling classes with identical test bodies (apart from the one class name D1 names), so the shard planner has finer bricks

R2.description: The committed shard timings are refreshed from real CI, a ratchet keeps multi-test atoms under 200 s, and the CI shard count rises only on the planner's own evidence

R3.description: The guides and the item page describe the shard count, the runner budget, the floor and the unsplit atoms
